items.title: Evaluating chain-of-thought monitorability
items.summary: OpenAI introduces a new framework and evaluation suite for chain-of-thought monitorability, covering 13 evaluations across 24 environments. Our findings show that monitoring a model’s internal reasoning is far more effective than monitoring outputs alone, offering a promising path toward scalable control as AI systems grow more capable.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI推出了一套全新的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）可监控性评估框架，涵盖了24个环境下的13项评估指标。研究表明，直接监控模型的内部推理过程比仅监控最终输出结果更为有效。该框架旨在为日益强大的AI系统提供可扩展的控制路径，通过量化推理过程的透明度，帮助开发者更好地理解和引导模型的决策逻辑，是迈向更安全、可控AI的重要技术尝试。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该评估框架为监控大模型内部推理过程提供了量化标准，对提升AI系统的可控性具有重要意义。

items.title: Deepening our collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy
items.summary: OpenAI and the U.S. Department of Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to deepen collaboration on AI and advanced computing in support of scientific discovery. The agreement builds on ongoing work with national laboratories and helps establish a framework for applying AI to high-impact research across the DOE ecosystem.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI与美国能源部（DOE）签署谅解备忘录，旨在深化在AI与先进计算领域的合作，以支持科学发现。双方将利用DOE的国家实验室资源，探索AI在高性能计算及高影响力科研项目中的应用框架。

items.title: AI literacy resources for teens and parents
items.summary: OpenAI shares new AI literacy resources to help teens and parents use ChatGPT thoughtfully, safely, and with confidence. The guides include expert-vetted tips for responsible use, critical thinking, healthy boundaries, and supporting teens through emotional or sensitive topics.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了针对青少年和家长的AI素养资源，旨在引导用户安全、负责任地使用ChatGPT。内容涵盖了批判性思维培养、健康边界设定及处理敏感话题的建议。

items.title: Updating our Model Spec with teen protections
items.summary: OpenAI is updating its Model Spec with new Under-18 Principles that define how ChatGPT should support teens with safe, age-appropriate guidance grounded in developmental science. The update strengthens guardrails, clarifies expected model behavior in higher-risk situations, and builds on our broader work to improve teen safety across ChatGPT.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI更新了其模型规范（Model Spec），引入了针对18岁以下用户的保护原则。该更新旨在确保ChatGPT为青少年提供符合发展科学的、年龄适宜的指导，并强化了高风险场景下的安全护栏。

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.2-Codex
items.summary: GPT-5.2-Codex is OpenAI’s most advanced coding model, offering long-horizon reasoning, large-scale code transformations, and enhanced cybersecurity capabilities.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式发布GPT-5.2-Codex模型，这是其目前最先进的代码专用大模型。该模型在长程推理能力、大规模代码重构与转换以及网络安全防护方面进行了显著增强。通过引入更深层的逻辑推理架构，GPT-5.2-Codex旨在解决复杂软件工程中的自动化难题，为开发者提供更高效的辅助编程体验，是代码生成领域的重要技术迭代。
